label: FS FS-AC32 wireless LAN controller
description: FS FS-AC32 - rack-mount wireless LAN controller with six 10/100/1000BASE-T ports, two USB ports and an RJ45 console port, managing FS Wi-Fi access points centrally; L2/L3 with 4000 VLANs. 430 x 250 x 45 mm.
notes: From FS's own comparison table on the AC-1004 page: '**6x 10/100/1000M Ports**', 'SFP Ports: —', 'USB Ports: 2', 'Console Ports: 1'. Six copper ports, no cages, one console. Only the ports are quoted here: the managed-AP count for this model is not in the table (the AC-1004's 64 is), so it is not stated rather than guessed from the model name - 'AC32' looking like '32 APs' is exactly the kind of inference this catalogue does not make.
